# AIVIVN original manual fallback

Official Kaggle source: `https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/mcocoz/aivivn-2019`

Place the original `train.csv` and `test.csv` files in this directory. The files must contain `id`, `comment`, and `label` columns. They are preserved for provenance only; Q1b uses the bundled `AIVIVN-human-derived-3way` split.

Configure Kaggle credentials through the standard environment or `KAGGLE_CONFIG_DIR`; never commit credentials or the original text.
